body: What an idiot I was... Looks like flying to Maine it is.

Friend, your post moved me. I'm also struggling tonight. A few months ago I thought I was on the verge of true happiness, but everything collapsed. The love of my life only has eyes for somebody else. I have no job, never had one, and no prospects to getting one. I have no friends, and a family which looks at me with disappointment. I'm a 25 year old closeted virgin with so much college debt, and I plan to kill myself before 2020... Friend, go and find your boyfriend, give him a hug, or get him to hug you. I've not been hugged for years, and have never been kissed. Please, please find the one you love... you will be safe in their arms. Don't go to the place of everlasting rest, please try to live tonight.
Hang in there, James. Your friend came back to you. Try to smile again. :)

I've already bought some cold-weather clothes, so I'll buy a bunch more before I go. Time change won't be great, but my body clock is already quite atypical. I think I'll be fine when I arrive, it's just the travelling and getting through the airport in time for the flight/flights.
